model.name: Hi3D v1.0 Mesh Refiner 2x1.8B
model.description: Hi3D v1.0 turns a coarse 3D mesh and a picture of the same object into a detailed, closed mesh (GLB, geometry only), at 512, 1024 or 1536 surface detail. Use it after Hunyuan3D 2.1 Shape, TripoSG or TRELLIS.2; it keeps their overall shape and adds fine relief, and 1024 takes a few minutes on a fast GPU.
